tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows only cover short horizons, leaving the dual-horizon reversal parameters unidentified for H=20. The supplied mechanism and probe guidance independently recommend the slow-horizon discriminating probe first.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the short-horizon pilot rows now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five have H≤0.48, so they do not identify the long-timescale adaptation or confirm behavior near the target horizon H=20.
More short-horizon samples do not resolve the stated long-horizon ambiguity.
Irrelevant to the candidate temporal mechanisms and needlessly costly.
Current evidence and branch guidance select the dual-horizon probe; the supercritical branch requires s_grad>2.36, while pilot maximum is 2.15.
